mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs remain low.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production above 105.0 during supply-driven expansion phases signals manufacturing recovery that boosts corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 235.0 triggers market anticipation of Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as risk assets face higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth above 140,000 thousand persons sustains consumer spending momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through persistent earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 140,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent month-over-month growth in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures drives immediate equity market optimism, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines below 105.0.
